headline: US House Prices Rise 2.5% Year-on-Year in Third Quarter
summary: US house prices increased 2.5% in the third quarter compared to the previous year, rising 0.7% from the prior quarter according to official data.
why: Housing price indexes serve as key indicators of consumer wealth effects, real estate sector health, and inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Real Estate Sector
impacts.why: Consistent year-on-year home price appreciation indicates resilience in the residential real estate market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
